subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT one of the fundamental rights mentioned in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Right to exploitation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Indian Constitution guarantees six fundamental rights to its citizens.
 
• The rights mentioned are Right to Equality, Right to Freedom, Right against Exploitation, Right to Freedom of Religion, Cultural and Educational Rights, and Right to Constitutional Remedies.
 
• There is no fundamental right called "Right to exploitation"; the correct term is "Right against Exploitation".
 
• The Right against Exploitation prohibits all forms of forced labor, child labor, and human trafficking.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Right to Equality:**

 
 
• It includes equality before law, prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth, and equality of opportunity in matters of public employment.
 
• Articles 14 to 18 of the Constitution cover this right.
 
 
 
• **Right to Freedom:**
 
 
• It includes freedom of speech and expression, assembly, association or union, movement, residence, and the right to practice any profession or occupation.
 
• Articles 19 to 22 of the Constitution cover this right.
 
 
 
• **Right against Exploitation:**
 
 
• It prohibits all forms of forced labor, child labor, and human trafficking.
 
• Articles 23 and 24 of the Constitution cover this right.
 
 
 
• **Right to Freedom of Religion:**
 
 
• It ensures religious freedom and secularism in India.
 
• Articles 25 to 28 of the Constitution cover this right.
 
 
 
• **Right to Constitutional Remedies:**
 
 
• It allows individuals to go to the courts for enforcement of the fundamental rights against the state.
 
• Articles 32 and 226 of the Constitution cover this right.
